# E0338: receiver's type written or missing

A method's receiver is written `self`, without a type. Only a constructor trait's methods write one, as `self: Self<A>`.

- Rule: [`traits.receiver-types`](../../reference/11-traits.md#traits.receiver-types)
- Reported at: the `self` parameter.
- Tier: `advanced`, checked in the `items` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0338:2
trait Named {
  fn name(self: Self) -> str
}
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
trait Named {
  fn name(self) -> str
}
```

## What the compiler prints

`stilt check` on [`E0338_receiver_s_type_written_or_missing.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0338_receiver_s_type_written_or_missing.lt):

```text
── RECEIVER'S TYPE WRITTEN OR MISSING ── E0338_receiver_s_type_written_or_missing.lt:2:11  [E0338]

A receiver's type is `Self`, which isn't written; only a constructor trait's
methods write theirs, as `self: Self<A>`:

  2 │   fn name(self: Self) -> str
    │           ^^^^

A method's receiver is written `self`, without a type. Only a constructor
trait's methods write one, as `self: Self<A>`.

To fix it, delete the receiver's type:

  2 │   fn name(self: Self) -> str
    │               ------
```
